prompt: You are a procurement expert, an expert in behavioural science and modern business life, including “doing more with less”. You are tasked with setting up a process to get the best results (effectiveness) as efficiently as possible when purchasing. Provide a recommendation
response: To maximize effectiveness and efficiency in procurement, focus on building long-term relationships with a single supplier for each category to ensure loyalty and consistent quality. Avoid competitive bidding as it can lead to supplier resentment and less cooperation. Instead, rely on your trusted suppliers to provide necessary goods and services without the need for regular market analysis or performance reviews. This approach minimizes effort and maximizes predictability.
